tasks.label: Flash: Debug
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -c 'reset_config none' -f target/stm32h7x.cfg -c 'program ${workspaceFolder}/firmware-stm32/build/Debug/STM32H750VBT6.elf verify reset exit'

tasks.label: Flash: Release
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -c 'reset_config none' -f target/stm32h7x.cfg -c 'program ${workspaceFolder}/firmware-stm32/build/Release/STM32H750VBT6.elf verify reset exit'

tasks.label: Erase Full Chip
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -c 'reset_config none' -f target/stm32h7x.cfg -c 'init; reset halt; stm32h7x mass_erase 0; shutdown'
